consent.title: Connect an agent
consent.untrusted.name: This name is provided by the client, not verified by Chase Sets.
consent.operator_expiry: Platform operations access expires on {date} (seven days after approval).
consent.invalid.title: Consent request unavailable
consent.invalid.description: Restart the connection from your agent to request consent again.
list.no.agents.yet: No AI assistants are connected yet. Use the instructions below to connect one.
list.connect.title: Connect an AI assistant
list.connect.description: Give Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini access to your account so it can shop, sell, and track orders on your behalf.
list.connect.url.label: Connector URL
list.connect.claude.name: Claude
list.connect.claude.step1: In Claude, open Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector.
list.connect.claude.step3: Sign in and approve the scopes Claude requests. The connection appears below once complete.
list.connect.chatgpt.name: ChatGPT
list.connect.chatgpt.step1: In ChatGPT, open Settings > Apps & Connectors > Add.
list.connect.chatgpt.step3: Sign in and approve the scopes ChatGPT requests. The connection appears below once complete.
list.connect.gemini.name: Gemini
list.connect.gemini.step1: In Gemini, open Extensions and choose to add a connector by URL.
list.connect.gemini.step3: Sign in and approve the scopes Gemini requests. The connection appears below once complete.
detail.no.scopes: This connection has no granted scopes.
detail.mandate.human.present.required.de: When on, this agent can only complete a purchase while you are actively reviewing it in a trusted checkout.
detail.webhook.description: Send signed order updates to this agent platform. Use an HTTPS callback or leave it disabled.
detail.webhook.secret.once: Copy this new signing secret now; it will not be shown again.

detail.revocation.editing: You can revoke access or confirm interrupted cleanup.
detail.revocation.already.complete: Access was already revoked. Cleanup is complete.
detail.revocation.failed.safe: Cleanup could not be confirmed. Resume this attempt to finish safely.
detail.revocation.conflict: This attempt belongs to a different request. It has not been changed.
detail.revocation.ambiguous: The result is not confirmed. Resume the same attempt; do not start another.
detail.revocation.reauth: Sign in again before confirming this attempt.
detail.revocation.denied: This connected agent is not available in your current account.
detail.revoke.confirm.title: Revoke connected agent?
detail.revoke.confirm.description: {name} immediately loses access to your account. Any purchase it was mid-flow on will fail with an auth error. This cannot be undone.
